title: When is a notes-only pull request delivered?
section: Notes-only jobs and jobs without a repository
body:
Settled: a repository job whose outcome is notes delivers like any other, with its job branch pushed and opened as a PR holding its notes (AssemblyAI#11); it gets no Quality validation unless the mandate asks, its leader's acceptance is the completion evidence, and its body says "notes only" (AssemblyAI#18). The sources do not say whether it opens as a draft and waits for CI, as a code PR does, or is ready at once.

Rule 38 in the draft is open until you answer.
rec: A. "Delivers like any other" reads as the same cycle, and a red check on a notes PR (a docs linter, a link checker) is something you would want to know before reviewing. The cost is a short wait on CI that uses no worker or allowance. B is quicker but can hand you a PR whose checks fail.
options: A: the same cycle as code: pushed, opened as a draft, marked ready when CI is green on its head (or straight away in a repository declared as having no CI); the job then ends
B: opened ready for review at once, without waiting for CI; the job ends when it is opened

title: What is the delivery owner's push request called?
body:
Settled: the daemon pushes the job branch when the delivery owner asks (AssemblyAI#18). The agent command set in AssemblyAI#9 was decided before that and has no command for asking; no ticket names one.

Rule 17 leaves the name open.
rec: A. It says exactly what the daemon does. Delivery has several steps that the leader drives itself (validation, the PR, CI), so a broader name such as B would promise more than the command does.
options: A: `asmai push <job>`, for the delivery owner only; it pushes the job branch, or refuses and records an outside change

title: How does your answer about CI become the no-CI declaration?
body:
The sources conflict. AssemblyAI#18 puts the no-CI declaration in the repository's configuration, has Coordination's repository setup ask about CI when a repository is added, and has the factory ask you after 15 minutes with no check. AssemblyAI#9 says agents may not change the factory's configuration: such a command refuses an agent and prints the command for you to run. Nothing says how an answer you give Coordination reaches the configuration.

Rule 31 is open until you answer.
rec: A. The declaration then lives in one place, the configuration, and only you change it, as AssemblyAI#9 requires; Coordination already works this way for `asmai repo add`. B leaves two places that can disagree about one repository.
options: A: Coordination gives you the configuration change to make, as it does for `asmai repo add`; the declaration exists only in the configuration, and a held job resumes once you apply it
B: your answer is recorded as a decision for that repository and counts as its declaration; a value you later set in the configuration takes precedence

title: Accept 06 Validation and delivery?
body: Accepting applies your answers above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start 07 Limits, holds and visibility. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
